Q1_hardlink_copy_contaminated.question: Does a Wine registry write reach a hardlink copy of the prefix?

Q2_full_copy_independent.question: Does a quiesced full copy stay unchanged after further writes?

Q3_post_copy_document_survives_restore.interpretation: If false, a naive whole-prefix restore silently destroys work created after the recovery point. This is the exact failure ADR-0017 rule 2 (tier separation) exists to prevent, and it is why runtime, prefix and user-document recovery must be separate operations.
Q3_post_copy_document_survives_restore.question: Does a user document created after the copy survive restoring that copy?
